title: Satisfying an interface
hints: A type satisfies an interface by having every method the interface lists. There's no `implements` keyword. Read the compiler error: which method is Circle missing?
Shape asks for Area() float64 and Perimeter() float64. Rect has both; Circle has only Area. A circle's perimeter is 2πr; math.Pi is available.
func (c Circle) Perimeter() float64 { return 2 * math.Pi * c.Radius }
